def diff(label):

    reg=Counter()

    print(label,"changed:",len(ch),"| regions(row//10,col//10,from->to):")
    for k,v in sorted(reg.items()): print("   ",k,v)
    before=after
before=snap(current_frame)

def snap(f): return f.ascii.split('\n')
def diff(label):
    global before
    after=snap(current_frame)
    ch=[(i,j,before[i][j],after[i][j]) for i in range(64) for j in range(64) if before[i][j]!=after[i][j]]

    reg=Counter()

    for k,v in sorted(reg.items()): print("   ",k,v)
    before=after
before=snap(current_frame)
